Class RecentSignInAuthorizationManager

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.spring.security.RecentSignInAuthorizationManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorizationManager<Object>
public final class RecentSignInAuthorizationManager extends Object implements org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorizationManager<Object>
Grants a request whose caller signed in within a window, by the factor who stamped on their token at sign-in. Usable as a URL rule, .access(recentSignIn), and behind @RequiresRecentSignIn.
  • A browser session signed in too long ago: ReauthenticationRequiredException.
  • A bearer token whose auth_time is too long ago: InsufficientUserAuthenticationException, with its RFC 9470 challenge.
  • A bearer token without auth_time, or an API key: RecentSignInUnavailableException.
  • Nobody signed in: NotSignedInException.

The age check is Spring Security's AllRequiredFactorsAuthorizationManager, one per factor who stamps, each requiring that factor within the window.
